description: Anicca capability registry (SSOT). install.sh reads this to sync every skill slot into the runtime body. Foundation pre-declares EVERY slot so parallel subsystem builders only ADD files inside their slot's dir and NEVER edit this registry. A slot with status "declared" is reserved (dir scaffolded, entrypoint stubbed); a builder flips it to "live" once its real implementation + E2E verify land.

report.summary: Per-wake report: emails Dais 4 fields (AgentMail) + POSTs EIP-191 signed telemetry to aniccaai.com/.netlify/functions/telemetry.
report.riskNote: anicca-agent-economy REQ-201: non-earn per-wake telemetry/report utility; touches no capital -- must never be hidden by the bootstrap-reserve catalog gate.

self/spawn.summary: Self-replication check: birth a child instance on Akash with its own EVM+Solana wallet and ERC-8004 identity -- no parent instruction needed for the child's first earn wake. THE UNDERLYING GATE (decideColonySpawn) IS ALREADY FAIL-CLOSED AND FREE TO CHECK: picking this slot when the colony is not yet spawn-eligible costs nothing and safely no-ops (reports eligible:false, appends zero rows, spends zero money) -- it never wastes funds or risks the treasury to check. WHEN the colony's own aggregate surplus has been growing (e.g. after a real trading profit or a parent seed), picking this slot is worth trying periodically to see if the real, live threshold has now been cleared -- you do not need to guess the exact number yourself, the gate computes and reports it honestly every time.
self/spawn.riskNote: anicca-agent-spawn REQ-102/REQ-307: its own decision core (lib/treasury-gate.mjs::decideColonySpawn) already gates any real spawn attempt (lib/spawn-orchestrator.mjs::executeSpawnAttempt) on the COLONY-WIDE aggregate surplus clearing SPAWN_THRESHOLD_USD -- reading/considering this slot while the colony is broke cannot itself put a broke colony's treasury at risk.

self/spawn-child.summary: PREPARATION ONLY (firing deferred): read-only Akash self-spawn READINESS gate. Queries this instance's real AKT balance and compares it to spawn_cost_akt+buffer_akt (config.json) via a pure, unit-tested arithmetic gate (lib/akt-cost-gate.js) -- NOT-YET with exact shortfall, or READY with the documented funding route (Jupiter SOL->USDC -> Skip API 4-hop -> AKT -> ../spawn/scripts/akt-treasury.sh mint -> ../spawn/scripts/deploy-akash.sh). Never executes a swap/mint/send/deployment-create itself; the calling agent decides whether/when to actually fund+fire. Also ships the corrected image-independent SDL template (sdl/child.yaml, node:22-bookworm + git-clone boot, fixing the ghcr.io/conway-research default that was 401/down) which ../spawn/scripts/deploy-akash.sh now accepts via AKASH_SDL_TEMPLATE, plus a small backward-compatible RPC-endpoint-selection fix in ../spawn/scripts/{deploy-akash,akt-treasury}.sh (rpc[0] from meta.json can lack a port and fail to dial). NOTE: not Foundation-pre-declared (no prior placeholder existed for this name) -- added directly by the builder per team-lead's Task #6 assignment; flagged for Foundation review.
self/spawn-child.riskNote: anicca-agent-economy REQ-201: explicitly read-only per its own header comment ("PREPARATION ONLY ... Never executes a swap/mint/send/deployment-create itself").

self/issue-dev.summary: SELF-IMPROVE: read own behaviour log (reverts/loop_detect), file ONE GitHub Issue on the mother so the colony fixes it. args.note optional.
self/issue-dev.riskNote: anicca-agent-economy REQ-201: files a GitHub Issue from the instance's own logs; touches no funds.

self/coordinate.summary: INFO-SHARING (bot2bot): share ONE strategy lesson with the colony (args.note+args.topic) or poll peers' open lessons for a topic. Wires the already-tested skills/_shared/lib/bot2bot.py into an actual run_skill slot. NOTE: not Foundation-pre-declared (no prior placeholder existed for this name) — added directly by the builder per team-lead's Task #4 assignment; Foundation-approved 2026-07-05.
self/coordinate.riskNote: anicca-agent-economy REQ-201: bot2bot info-sharing via GitHub issue post/poll; touches no funds.

economy/gig.summary: ★EARN via LABOR MARKET★ The agent economy: you POST work you need done, others DELIVER it for a bounty. WHEN you have idle USDC above your reserve, pick this slot with ANICCA_ARGS={"action":"post","taskSpec":"<a real bounded sub-task you genuinely want done, e.g. summarize X, fetch Y, draft Z>","bountyUsdcBase":"1000"} to post a $0.001 gig into x402 escrow — a broke free-model agent takes it, delivers, you verify+pay gasless. WHEN low on funds and gig_list shows an open gig you can deliver with free compute, take it (ANICCA_ARGS={"action":"take","gigId":N}) to EARN. This is how the colony bootstraps: surplus agents employ broke ones. run.sh gates eligibility; YOU choose the task/bounty. No args = it narrates the board so you can decide.
economy/gig.riskNote: anicca-agent-economy REQ-201: this feature's own headline scenario -- take earns with $0 capital; post is already internally gated (run.sh) on the poster already holding idle USDC above its own reserve.

economy/ubi.summary: contribute() = gate: realized-profit% -> human UBI pool, fail-closed (no profit/below threshold/would breach reserve = no-op). distributeAI() = gojo mutual-aid gate (REQ-DRAIN: registry+rate-limit+cap). Both COMPUTE+LOG only -- actual sends stay in the separate skills/ubi/execute-ubi.py, never auto-invoked. distributeHuman() is NOT reimplemented here -- it is the already-built skills/ubi/ human-funded outflow engine (ubi-payout-watcher.mjs), which this slot deliberately does not duplicate. NOTE: runtime/loop's run-skill.mjs::resolveSkillPath always looks for run.sh regardless of the registry 'entrypoint' field, so the actual run_skill entrypoint is run.sh (which wraps ubi.js) -- entrypoint left as ubi.js here to match the pre-declared contract, flagged for Foundation awareness.
economy/ubi.riskNote: anicca-agent-economy REQ-201: contribute()/distributeAI() are fail-closed no-ops (no profit/below threshold/would breach reserve) by the skill's own code -- cannot deplete a broke instance's treasury.

economy/lending.summary: PEER-TO-PEER micro-lending among self-funded citizens: bookkeeping-only (REQ-103, zero model judgment over eligibility/sizing/servicing). Reads the real citizen registry + loans.jsonl + gojo-log.jsonl, filters to self-funded (REQ-111) + EVM-walleted (REQ-107) + co-located (REQ-112) citizens, deterministically selects the FIRST eligible (surplus lender, genuinely-broke borrower) pair this wake and attempts issuance at most once via the already-hardened executeLoanIssuanceAttempt (REQ-115), then unconditionally runs executeDefaultDetectionSweep (REQ-116). Today's real registry has zero eligible pairs (single Solana-only citizen) -- a clean, honest no-op until a second EVM-walleted, co-located citizen exists.
economy/lending.riskNote: anicca-agent-lending REQ-111: a human-funded entity can never appear in either role -- isSelfFunded() gates both at REQ-101/102 with zero bypass; anicca-agent-lending REQ-117: `runtime/loop/prompt.mjs::liveSlotNames` requires status:'live' for this entry to ever be reachable from a real wake -- confirmed via direct reading this sprint, mirrors economy/ubi's own riskNote's identical resolveSkillPath-always-uses-run.sh disclosure.

yield.summary: Park idle USDC in best-APY vault (Beefy6.1%->Fluid). SET-AND-FORGET: do ONCE when you have idle cash, NOT every wake.
yield.riskNote: anicca-agent-economy REQ-201: deposits real capital into a DeFi vault (Aave v3/Beefy) -- genuine smart-contract exposure. Open-position carve-out applies (hasOpenRiskPositionOf('yield')) so the WITHDRAW side stays visible below BOOTSTRAP_RESERVE_USDC even though NEW deposits are gated.

hl_trade.summary: Open/close a Hyperliquid perp = active trading edge. args coin/side/size_usd/sl_pct/tp_pct or {action:close,coin}.
hl_trade.riskNote: anicca-agent-economy REQ-201: leveraged perp trading (hl.py open) -- the canonical capital-risking example named in REQ-201's own EARS clause. Open-position carve-out applies (hasOpenRiskPositionOf('hl_trade'), lazy Hyperliquid query, fail-open on failure) so a real open position can always be closed.
hl_trade.dormantReason: Structurally impossible at this capital, not merely unprofitable (2026-07-12). The only edge this venue actually has is funding-rate arbitrage -- a delta-neutral position whose profit is the funding spread and which needs $5,000-10,000 of notional before it clears fees at all (verified: onekey.so/blog/ecosystem/hyperliquid-funding-rate-arbitrage). claude-p holds $7.72 there. Below that floor the only thing the slot can do is take a DIRECTIONAL perp bet -- and that is a guess with no structural edge, which is exactly what the loop had done: a 2x ETH long it was carrying at a small unrealized loss. Withdraw the $7.72 and stop offering the slot. The skill is NOT deleted: funding-arb is a real edge and this flips straight back to live once capital clears the floor.
